news.title: Full stability and persistence hardening
news.details: Thread-safe cloud/profile state application, safer atomic saves, proper Windows GUI build and embedded Cursor Control icon.

news.title: Ship materials and Expedition rewards
news.details: Added the six Ship Module material sprites and redesigned Space Expedition completion rewards with clear icons and quantities.

news.title: Void Serpent Hunt combo feedback
news.details: Added remaining-hit flashes beside Hunt nodes and five escalating hit sounds, including a dedicated destruction finisher.

news.title: 72 Ship Module sprites
news.details: Replaced generic module placeholders with the complete 9 x 8 authored Ship Module sprite set.

news.title: Five-hit Void Serpent Hunt nodes
news.details: Every Hunt node now requires five successful hits before destruction while preserving the existing safety pocket behaviour.

news.title: Startup intro isolation
news.details: Moved the intro video to a dedicated splash presentation so the real game window is not visible before the intro.

news.title: Startup and game initialisation maintenance
news.details: Maintenance build retaining the revised startup/game initialisation path used by the current client.

news.title: Intro playback compatibility
news.details: Kept the supplied MP4 as the primary intro and added the compatibility path used by the later splash-window implementation.

news.title: Game initialisation maintenance
news.details: Maintenance build in the startup/initialisation series retained by the current client.

news.title: Weekly boundary hotfix
news.details: Competition and weekly score windows now reset at Monday 00:00 Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh after the full Sunday has elapsed.
